topic.title: Roopkund, the skeleton lake
topic.angle: Hundreds of skeletons around a Himalayan lake at ~5,000 m; long thought one hailstorm; 2019 DNA showed groups dying about 1,000 years apart, some of Eastern Mediterranean ancestry
key_facts: Roopkund is a glacial lake at about 5,000 m in Chamoli district, Uttarakhand
A forest ranger reported the skeletons in 1942; they show when the snow melts
Estimates range from about 300 to 800 individuals
An older theory: one group killed together in a hailstorm
A 2019 DNA study (Harney et al., Nature Communications) found distinct groups dying about 1,000 years apart, one with Eastern Mediterranean (Greek/Cretan-like) ancestry around 1800 CE
